name: super-productivity-plugin-caldav-sync
description: Super Productivity plugin that syncs scheduled tasks to a CalDAV calendar

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/plugin.js --banner:js="/* CalDAV Schedule Sync Plugin for Super Productivity — built from src/, do not edit. */"
scripts.package: npm run test && npm run build && zip -j dist/caldav-sync.zip dist/plugin.js manifest.json config.schema.json README.md LICENSE
